channel.title: NoBadge Updates
channel.description: Signed NoBadge updates. A purchase license is required.

item.title: NoBadge 0.1.47
item.description: Add Help & Recovery → Recover missing badges. Review the saved apps and confirm recovery to restore their badge settings and refresh macOS. Automatic hiding stays off afterward. Without saved originals, recovery refreshes macOS without enabling additional badges. Pending System Settings recovery still uses its existing adapter; completed system-attention counters and custom app-drawn badges are outside this recovery. macOS compatibility is unchanged.
